notes.title: The End of the Sun - Out now! A Story-Driven Adventure in Slavic Myths
notes.content:
Hi! 

The End of the Sun is out now!
We’re excited to share the news about the release of The End of The Sun, a story-driven adventure game steeped in Slavic mythology, developed by our friends from The End of the Sun Team.

The game was launched 7 days, January 29, 2025, Now is ready to play! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/912840/The_End_of_the_Sun/

if you’re enjoying the game, please leave a review on Steam.
It doesn't have to be long sophisticated text, even a few words are enough :) 
It's really important for such small time like The End of the Sun Team.


More about The End of the Sun
As the ashter, a Slavic sage sorcerer gifted with the ability to travel in time and knowledge about the otherworld, following the trail of the unusual fugitive, you come to a mysterious village. Unfortunately, you cannot find anyone there, at least not in the way you expected to. All you can see around you are burned hearths.

The game is inspired by Slavic mythology and legends. The story presents the mysterious events occurring during the major Slavic festivals in all four seasons, far away from each other in time. The gameplay is a mix of exploration and adventure mystery games with unorthodox riddles to solve, but the storyline comes first here.

To give you a closer look, we shared a Release Date Trailer focused on the artistic side of the game, music and atmosphere! (Subtitles in many languages available)

[previewyoutube=Zqf_P-xnYYw;full][/previewyoutube]

Immerse yourself in the enchanting Slavic fantasy world of The End of The Sun with its official soundtrack! This collection of 28 atmospheric tracks is designed to evoke deep emotions and enhance your connection to the game’s story-driven mystery adventure.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3225340/The_End_of_the_Sun_Soundtrack/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7354830/9d099e56e567fa21501a075c8610a9c023f7609b.jpg

Thanks!

notes.title: If you like adventure story-driven games, The End of the Sun it's for YOU!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

Check out this amazing game from our friends! 

The game has been creating by 2 developers full time for over 6 years.


The End of the Sun is a first-person exploration and adventure story-driven game set in the Slavic fantasy world. As the ashter (sorcerer) who is gifted with the ability to travel in time, you come to a mysterious village, but you cannot find anyone there, at least not as you expected.


The game is beautifully designed with stunning visuals and a captivating story. You will explore the village, and solve puzzles, as you try to unravel the mystery of what happened to the villagers.

If you are a fan of Slavic mythology, adventure games, or first-person exploration games, then you will love The End of the Sun. 

Check it out today and add it to your Steam Wishlist! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/912840/The_End_of_the_Sun/

FRESH TRAILER & STEAM STORE
THANKS TO YOUR REVIEWS!

We read a lot of Your reviews and we are grateful for that!  Based on that we decided to Refresh our Steam Store page. We added new gifs and updated the trailer with a professional Voice-over!

POINT AND CLICK OR VISUAL NOVEL?

What many of Your reviews are about  is that The Mira was promoted as Point and Click game and according to You it is a visual novel with adventure game elements. You Have right and sorry for that misunderstanding. We updated descriptions and tags of the game so it reflects better what actual gameplay is. Here is what the actual description of the game looks like:

"Mira is a Slavic-themed visual novel game with point and click and adventure games elements. It is about the magical journey of the titular heroine. From destroyed during world war II city of Cracow, she travels to a world of Slavic myths and legends."
